entry.title: Filing Plats of Survey; New Mexico, Oklahoma
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Land Management Bureau. Published 2026-08-20. Docket A2407-014-004-065516, #O2509-014-004-125222, LLNM931000.
The plats of survey and the supplemental plat of the following described lands are scheduled to be officially filed 30 calendar days after the date of this publication in the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) New Mexico State Office. The surveys and plat announced in this notice are necessary for the management of these lands.

entry.title: Public Land Order No. 7969; Withdrawal Revocation Calcasieu Radio Beacon Station, Calcasieu, Cameron Parish, Louisiana
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Land Management Bureau. Published 2026-08-11. Effective 2026-08-11. Docket A2407-014-004-065515, O2509-014-004-125222, LLESJ0000, LAES-106743780.
This order revokes a withdrawal created by an Executive Order dated November 22, 1875, which reserved land at the mouth of the Calcasieu River in Louisiana for lighthouse purposes. The approximately 2.97-acres identified for return to the public domain has been managed for lighthouse purposes since 1875. The public land was closed to the general land laws and location and entry under the United States mining laws. The Bureau of Land Management (BLM) has evaluated the land and determined it is suitable for return to the public domain.

entry.title: Proposed Reinstatement of Terminated Oil and Gas Lease WYW179793, Wyoming
entry.summary:
Notice. Interior Department; Land Management Bureau. Published 2026-08-06. Docket A2407-014-004-065516, #O2509-014-004-125222, LLWY920000. L57000000.FI0000. 17XL5017AR.
In accordance with the Mineral Leasing Act of 1920, as amended, the Bureau of Land Management (BLM) received a petition for reinstatement of terminated competitive oil and gas lease WYW179793 in Converse County, Wyoming. The lessee filed the petition for reinstatement on time and has met all filing requirements. No leases were issued that affect these lands. The Bureau of Land Management proposes to reinstate the lease.
